claims.claim_text: Enterprise technology leadership centers on an alliance-led operating model, with IBM-AWS co-sell leadership connecting partner execution to governed modernization and repeatable customer value.
From that commercial base, regulated modernization delivery embeds release automation and security scanning to strengthen secure, resilient execution.
Against that lineage backdrop, joint solution development and alliance cadence shape repeatable go-to-market motions across financial-services modernization opportunities.
In parallel, platform productization links IP-led revenue, margin expansion, and team scale, with $22M in IP-led revenue demonstrating business impact.
That operating discipline is measured in 20% joint revenue growth, giving partner strategy a concrete commercial signal.
The record supports future leadership of partner-led AI solutions where platform IP, secure delivery, and alliance growth reinforce one another.
